name: 2-1C medical droid
description: The 2-1C medical droid was a combat medic droid employed by the Galactic Empire. It was extremely similar in design to the FX-series medical assistant droid, but was designed for independent operation on the battlefield. It had a working vocabulator and a cruel, cynical attitude, a stark contrast to the eager, friendly IM-6 units used by the previous Grand Army of the Republic.
